sentences: i think after checking all the pairs the array gets sorted in one pass maybe.
the loop runs through the array and puts smaller numbers first so it becomes sorted i think.
maybe because compared a of j and j plus one, swapping when bigger, so all get in order.
not sure but each swap moves the big value right and finally we get 1 2 3.
i think doing the for loop from zero to one checks everything and sorts it.
